interpretation.supported: m_vecUpgrades is tested as a replay-runtime vector of Source2 item string-token IDs. The artifact reconstructs set membership changes and maps observed IDs to installed-build resource records when possible.
interpretation.notYetSupported: Vector additions are not yet labeled purchases, removals are not yet labeled sales, and mixed add/remove packets are not yet labeled upgrades. Those semantics require economy/shop-zone/component validation.
interpretation.arraySemantics: Set differences are used instead of slot-position differences so ordinary vector compaction does not create false item removal/addition events.
interpretation.buildScope: Mapping is against the current installed-build resource catalog. Unknown IDs may represent replay/build drift or resource classes outside Script138 V02 coverage and must be diagnosed rather than discarded.
